target_customer: Fundamental long/short and long-only equity funds and their analysts
problem: Public equity analysts must track earnings, news and non-traditional data across many companies by hand. Cohesion offers AI agents that monitor coverage and surface insights.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to investment funds (pricing not found)
product_category: AI research agents for public equity investing

founders.name: Devon Krapcho
prior_employers: Long Path Partners (hedge fund analyst covering software, 5+ years)

founders.name: Matt Munns
prior_employers: T. Rowe Price (built AI for investors)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that ingest earnings, news and alternative data and produce reliable analyst-grade output need data pipelines and accuracy work, but build on frontier models.

defensibility.rationale: Well funded incumbents such as AlphaSense, Hebbia and Rogo sell AI research. A moat would come from fund workflow integration and proprietary alternative data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet observable. Comparison pages in 2026 list these vendors as active alternatives, and another Spring 2026 YC company (KelAI) targets hedge fund research.

market_need_then: YC's Spring 2026 Requests for Startups included AI-native hedge funds. The company claims it is live with 10 plus funds managing 10 billion dollars plus combined, a company claim not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: Uses cohesionplatform.com rather than an exact match domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain tagline: Modern Intelligence for Finance

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real word shared with other companies, including a Chicago smart buildings company named Cohesion, and no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Cohesion is a Spring 2026 company, still active, with three founders from hedge fund, AWS and T. Rowe Price backgrounds. It claims early fund customers. No exit, shutdown or layoff reports exist. The crowded AI finance research market and a generic name are the main risks, but outcomes are not yet known.
